content: Play Billing: Billing 8 required for all new apps and updates by Aug 31 2026 (extension to Nov 1 2026 possible); Billing 9.0.0 already released 2026-05-19 so a Billing 9 deadline will follow in 2027. react-native-iap 14.7.x (active, Apr 2026) ships Play Billing 8.x via openiap and StoreKit 2 on iOS (iOS 15+), works via Expo dev client not Expo Go.
